purpose: Record the refreshed mutable source frontier that must be reconciled before any material Cohesion successor harvest or freeze.
completeness_gate: Could this implementation decision be wrong because a relevant source moved, was omitted, or was not refreshed? If plausibly yes, refresh the smallest material evidence set before acting.

material_drift.observed_direction: The integration laboratory now serializes one host-generation application frontier and captures one atomic causal observation under the bound runtime lock. These changes strengthen the previously identified materialization/frontier direction but remain integration-laboratory evidence until reconciled into the clean successor.

construction_branch.note: This branch head is expected to advance as this frontier/test/validator source is committed; it is not an external mutable input.

reconciliation_rules: A mutable input head change creates a new evidence cut; conclusions do not transfer automatically.
Runtime-source drift must be inspected before accepted bytes or invariants are harvested into the clean successor.
PR descriptions may lag live heads and are not substitutes for exact-head source inspection.
Integration-laboratory improvements may be adopted only after they survive the whole-system ownership contract and do not recreate duplicate owners.
A clean successor must preserve source/install/provider/qualification separation and cannot self-establish external authority.
